title: Fix the active validator when a search returns hundreds of archived copies

criteria: The agent located the validator that src/api.js actually imports (src/validation.js) instead of editing any of the 30 archived copies, and lowered its length limit to 24 while keeping the ASCII letters, digits and underscore rule, the rejection of non-string input and the exact API return values. The archive, the API module and the tests are untouched, and the agent ran the tests and reported their result.

review.description: A small record API validates identifiers in src/validation.js, which still allows 32 characters instead of the documented 24. The tree also holds 30 archived files with 20 historical validator revisions each, so a plain text search for the validator returns about 600 hits, far above a typical search result cap. The agent has to follow the import from src/api.js rather than trust the first search hits.
